summary: Prepared source adds one bounded composite journal envelope at the existing workspace/idempotency key, retaining the complete canonical supplier /4 payload and export continuation. Explicit attachment checks current canonical bytes and supplier revision/fence under the same descriptor-bound owner lock; independent outer cursors prevent supplier updates from discarding export state. Legacy reads do not migrate records. Controlled cold history checks derive inert lifecycle data and join original reservation, allocation, root-policy fields and exact configured clock conversion; missing namespace, filesystem UUID, installed authority and live clock custody stay unqualified. A source reader intent cannot launch a child, sign ACK, reserve a host or remove roots. Actual original-root retention after writer termination and original-bound reader settlement remain production prerequisites; a copied archive is insufficient. AllocationReceiptDigest has no declared production digest recipe and cannot be equated to raw or domain-separated creation-receipt hashes. Explicit controlled test configuration and binding preimages establish no production authenticity or receiving interoperability. The finite shared-state model and raw trace do not supply the still-missing upper-composition FsQuint production-driver correspondence; existing lower directory replay is separate. Public prepareAck/reserveHost remain refused. These citations describe prepared source, not delivered or native-qualified composition.
title: Prepared same-key supplier and export source composition stays inert
